phase_name: CI honesty: flush the stale PR queue
note: Phase 8 ship 5: DB contract check #62, upcoming events carry a cover image. Ricky's call 2026-08-03 after the og-preview diagnosis -- the coverless-event link-preview wart was DEFERRED as app code (only 1 of 65 published events is coverless and it is PAST), but the class gets a data-layer guard so it fires while an event is still upcoming and fixable. Deliberately needs NO admin migration: get_calendar_events_v2 is already anon-callable and already returns slug + cover_image_url, so migration authority stays untouched. Two self-inflicted defects caught while writing it, both classes this repo already documents: a SHEBANG broke the spec's import (vitest compiles through vm.Script, which does not strip it, and reports a SyntaxError at line 2 -- check-image-widths.mjs carries the same warning); and the top-level `await main()` ran a live RPC on IMPORT, so the spec went green having silently called prod (collect time 813ms -> 241ms once guarded). A third was caught by the write path rather than by me: a doubled backslash in a regex was halved in transit, producing an unterminated literal, and safe-write's parse check refused the write and restored the backup. Window is bounded by PostgREST's 1000-row cap, not by taste -- the first draft used 365 days, which measured 1445 rows in SQL and returned exactly 1000 through the RPC, i.e. it silently skipped a third of the horizon while printing 'all covered'. 180d = 735 rows, and a ROW_CAP tripwire reds rather than truncating quietly.
